desc: Build and analyze exhaustive small-N BFS data to identify reachability invariants and falsify simple matching/gap hypotheses.
Prove key invariants of the operation, including support-count behavior, ordering, and necessary target conditions.
Derive a precise reachability characterization in terms of the positions of `1`s in `A` and `B`.
Derive and prove the minimum-operation formula/algorithm once reachability holds.
Validate the characterization and cost formula against exhaustive brute force for very small `N`.
Implement the resulting Python solution with buffered input/output.
